description: Example benchmark for invariant discovery over active supporting cases.

entries.label: approve_multi_case_scope_boundary
entries.title: Scope boundaries must be enforced before ranking
entries.summary: Authority boundaries should prune candidates before ranking or fusion.
entries.statement: When records carry scope or authority boundaries, those boundaries must be enforced before ranking or fusion so unauthorized candidates cannot influence the result set.
entries.why_it_is_stable: The need to enforce authority boundaries survives backend changes because it is rooted in governance rather than any single retrieval implementation.
applicability_conditions: Multiple scopes can appear in one candidate pool
non_applicability_conditions: The caller explicitly asked for unbounded global search

entries.label: block_mismatched_cases
entries.title: Variant truth should be explicit before ranking
entries.summary: Mismatched cases should not become one invariant.
entries.statement: Variant truth and retrieval scope should both be enforced before ranking because they are explicit authority boundaries.
entries.why_it_is_stable: Both cases talk about preserving explicit truth.

entries.label: block_single_case_multi_case
entries.title: One case is not enough for multi-case promotion
entries.summary: The discovery surface must reject multi-case promotion with only one source case.
entries.statement: A single source case cannot satisfy a multi-case invariant promotion basis.
entries.why_it_is_stable: The invariant contract requires multiple supporting cases for multi-case promotion.
